_about: Video studios (law 25): the studios of the original studio + Genjutsu and DoP presets, mapped to what Open TAN can run. One entry = one studio card on the Video Director page (the owner's words pick the studio: `studio vdirect`). status: ready = runs now · partial = runs in part / by a workaround · none = needs an engine (the owner picks; ask before anything paid). Source: git HEAD packages/studio (original repo), notes/CAMERA-MAP.md.

studios.label: Text & Image to Video
studios.what: A shot from a prompt, or a still that starts (and ends) the shot.
options: Wan 2.x (local via Wan2GP or a Kaggle GPU)
studios.original: Video Studio — text-to-video (40+ models) and image-to-video (60+ models)

flow.input: ingredients · frames when a start / end image is given
flow.why: 8 s with sound for 10 credits is the best value; exact 4–6 s → Omni 1.1 (until 5 Dec), 3 s → Omni 1.2

studios.label: Cinema
studios.what: A cinematic shot built from a real camera, lens, focal length and aperture.
studios.original: Cinema Studio — 6 cameras, 11 lenses, 6 focal lengths, 3 apertures turned into prompt modifiers

flow.input: ingredients (or frames from a Nano Banana still)
flow.why: Veo reads real camera / lens language best; 8 s, sound, 10 credits

studios.label: Camera Moves & Effects
studios.what: One named move or effect per shot: a preset is a fixed prompt template + settings; you add a still or a line.
studios.engine: Google Flow · Veo 3.1 (the move written into the prompt; no preset templates saved yet)
studios.original: DoP — presets with filter chips: Effects · Basic Camera Control · Epic Camera Control · Catch the Pulse · Mix

flow.why: Omni is strongest on FPV, orbit and zoom-out moves; within budget at 720p only for 3 s (9) → else Veo Lite 8 s

studios.label: Lip Sync
studios.what: A face speaks a voice: a portrait + audio becomes a talking video, or a video's lips are re-synced to new audio.
studios.engine: Google Flow · Veo 3.1 speaks a line you write, in its own voice. Driving a face with your own audio needs a lip-sync engine.
options: Image + audio: Infinite Talk · Wan 2.2 Speech-to-Video · LTX 2.3 Lipsync
Video + audio: Sync Lipsync · LatentSync · Creatify · Veed · Infinite Talk V2V
Open source on a free Kaggle GPU: LatentSync · Infinite Talk · Wan 2.2 S2V
studios.original: Lip Sync Studio — 9 models across Portrait Image and Video modes

flow.why: Omni 1.2 has the better lip sync, several speakers and custom voices; Veo Lite speaks a written line with its own voice for 10

studios.label: AI Influencer
studios.what: One consistent made-up person (face, body, style) used again and again across stills and video.
studios.engine: Character sheet with studio ref character (Flow images) → studio video --start-frame
studios.command: studio ref character "<description>" → studio video "<scene>" --start-frame <sheet image>
options: a trained LoRA on a Kaggle GPU
studios.original: AI Influencer Studio — builder with Face / Body / Style tabs

flow.input: ingredients: the character sheet (made free on Nano Banana)
flow.why: Omni keeps a face, body and clothes the same across clips (up to 6 references)

studios.label: Recast
studios.what: Swap the person in a video for your character; the motion, camera and scene stay.
options: Wan 2.2 Animate (replace mode, open source; local or Kaggle GPU)
studios.original: Recast Studio — Video + Character image → Swap Body

flow.why: Omni 1.2 can edit an existing clip at the normal per-second price — not built yet

studios.label: Genjutsu
studios.what: Turn one video into many: keep its motion, change who and what is in it, or redraw it in a style.
inputs: Up to 30 images: characters, products, clothes
Mode: Motion transfer · Objects swap · Restyle
studios.original: Motion Control Studio (Motion Transfer · Objects Swap) + Genjutsu (Motion Library, Styles)

flow.why: motion transfer / restyle through Omni 1.2 edit — not built yet

studios.label: Vibe Motion
studios.what: Motion graphics written as code: type, shapes, charts, UI, rendered to video. No model hallucination.
studios.engine: Made by code on this Mac (HyperFrames / FoxMotion), not a video model; not yet linked to this board
studios.original: Vibe Motion Studio — React / Remotion motion graphics, remixable

flow.why: motion graphics are rendered from code: 0 credits

studios.label: Marketing Ads
studios.what: A video ad from a product and an avatar: product, person and script in one shot.
studios.engine: Poster or product still (law 6 kit) as the start frame → Google Flow · Veo 3.1
studios.original: Marketing Studio — Product + Avatar + References slots, @image mentions, format presets

flow.why: Omni holds packaging text and brand colours; product spins and ads are its listed uses

studios.label: AI Clipping
studios.what: A long video becomes short clips: find the strongest moments, cut them, reframe to 9:16.
studios.engine: No engine yet (possible locally: transcript + ffmpeg cuts)
options: Local: whisper transcript + ffmpeg + face-tracked reframe
studios.original: AI Clipping Studio — highlights timeline, extracted clips, aspect ratio

flow.input: local cut of a long video
